metadata.question: Was the vegetation anomaly in February 21-28 2019 (compared to the long-term average of the same month from 2003-2017) worse in Namibia than Zimbabwe?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Collections: Primary = MODIS/006/MOD13A2 (Terra, 16-day NDVI, 1 km). Fallback = MODIS/006/MYD13A2 (Aqua).
- 2019 target window: 2019-02-21 to 2019-03-01 (covers Feb 21–28 within 16-day composite). If empty, widen to 2019-02-15 to 2019-03-05.
- Climatology: All February images from 2003–2017 using calendarRange filters.
- Locations: Namibia and Zimbabwe from USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Use MOD13A2 SummaryQA <= 1 (best or good) to mask low-quality pixels. Scale NDVI by 0.0001.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- C1: If both Terra and Aqua collections are empty for 2019 window or climatology February 2003–2017.
- C2: If valid pixel count after masking is 0 for either country in 2019.
- C3: If any computed mean NDVI is null/NaN or outside [-1, 1].
- Otherwise, compare anomalies: anomaly = NDVI_2019 − Feb climatology. "Worse in Namibia" means anomaly is more negative in Namibia than in Zimbabwe.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const countries = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017');
    const namibia = countries.filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Namibia')).geometry();
    const zimbabwe = countries.filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Zimbabwe')).geometry();

    const tStart1 = ee.Date('2019-02-21');
    const tEnd1 = ee.Date('2019-03-01');
    const tStart2 = ee.Date('2019-02-15');
    const tEnd2 = ee.Date('2019-03-05');

    const MOD = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD13A2'); // Terra 16-day 1km NDVI
    const MYD = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD13A2'); // Aqua 16-day 1km NDVI

    function maskScaleMOD13(img) {
      const ndvi = img.select('NDVI').multiply(0.0001).rename('ndvi');
      const qa = img.select('SummaryQA');
      const good = qa.lte(1); // 0=best, 1=good
      return ndvi.updateMask(good);
    }

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    const ter19_1 = MOD.filterDate(tStart1, tEnd1);
    const ter19_2 = MOD.filterDate(tStart2, tEnd2);
    const aqu19_1 = MYD.filterDate(tStart1, tEnd1);
    const aqu19_2 = MYD.filterDate(tStart2, tEnd2);

    const climTerra = MOD
      .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2003, 2017, 'year'))
      .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'month'));
    const climAqua = MYD
      .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2003, 2017, 'year'))
      .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'month'));

    const sizes = await ee.Dictionary({
      ter19_1: ter19_1.size(),
      ter19_2: ter19_2.size(),
      aqu19_1: aqu19_1.size(),
      aqu19_2: aqu19_2.size(),
      climTerra: climTerra.size(),
      climAqua: climAqua.size()
    }).evaluate();

    let used2019Col = null;
    let used2019Note = '';
    if (sizes.ter19_1 > 0) {
      used2019Col = ter19_1; used2019Note = 'Terra (Feb21–Mar01)';
    } else if (sizes.ter19_2 > 0) {
      used2019Col = ter19_2; used2019Note = 'Terra (Alt: Feb15–Mar05)';
    } else if (sizes.aqu19_1 > 0) {
      used2019Col = aqu19_1; used2019Note = 'Aqua (Feb21–Mar01)';
    } else if (sizes.aqu19_2 > 0) {
      used2019Col = aqu19_2; used2019Note = 'Aqua (Alt: Feb15–Mar05)';
    } else {
      console.log(`2019 Images: 0 (no Terra/Aqua in both primary and alt windows)`);
      console.log('Climatology Feb 2003–2017 Images: ' + (sizes.climTerra + sizes.climAqua));
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    let usedClimCol = null;
    let climNote = '';
    if (sizes.climTerra > 0) {
      usedClimCol = climTerra; climNote = 'Terra';
    } else if (sizes.climAqua > 0) {
      usedClimCol = climAqua; climNote = 'Aqua';
    } else {
      console.log(`2019 Images: ${sizes.ter19_1 + sizes.ter19_2 + sizes.aqu19_1 + sizes.aqu19_2}`);
      console.log('Climatology Feb 2003–2017 Images: 0 (no Terra/Aqua)');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    const img2019 = used2019Col.map(maskScaleMOD13).mean();
    const imgClim = usedClimCol.map(maskScaleMOD13).mean();

    // 3. Processing (valid pixel counts)
    function regionStats(geom) {
      const totalPx = ee.Image.constant(1).rename('const').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('const');

      const valid2019 = img2019.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('ndvi');

      const mean2019 = img2019.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('ndvi');

      const meanClim = imgClim.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('ndvi');

      return ee.Dictionary({
        totalPx: totalPx,
        valid2019: valid2019,
        mean2019: mean2019,
        meanClim: meanClim
      });
    }

    const namStats = regionStats(namibia);
    const zimStats = regionStats(zimbabwe);

    const out = await ee.Dictionary({
      info2019: used2019Col.size(),
      info2019Note: used2019Note,
      infoClim: usedClimCol.size(),
      infoClimNote: climNote,
      nam: namStats,
      zim: zimStats
    }).evaluate();

    // 4. Validation & Final Answer
    function safeNum(x) {
      return (x === null || x === undefined) ? null : Number(x);
    }

    const n_total = safeNum(out.nam.totalPx);
    const n_valid = safeNum(out.nam.valid2019);
    const n_mean19 = safeNum(out.nam.mean2019);
    const n_meanCl = safeNum(out.nam.meanClim);

    const z_total = safeNum(out.zim.totalPx);
    const z_valid = safeNum(out.zim.valid2019);
    const z_mean19 = safeNum(out.zim.mean2019);
    const z_meanCl = safeNum(out.zim.meanClim);

    // Print concise evidence
    console.log(`2019 16-day Images: ${out.info2019} (${out.info2019Note}); Climatology Feb 2003–2017 Images: ${out.infoClim} (${out.infoClimNote})`);

    // C2 check: no valid pixels after masking
    if (!n_valid || !z_valid || n_valid === 0 || z_valid === 0) {
      const n_cloud = (n_total ? (100 * (1 - (n_valid || 0) / n_total)).toFixed(1) : 'NA');
      const z_cloud = (z_total ? (100 * (1 - (z_valid || 0) / z_total)).toFixed(1) : 'NA');
      console.log(`Namibia ValidPx: ${n_valid || 0}/${n_total || 0} (~${n_cloud}% cloud/masked)`);
      console.log(`Zimbabwe ValidPx: ${z_valid || 0}/${z_total || 0} (~${z_cloud}% cloud/masked)`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // C3 check: invalid/NaN values or out of NDVI plausible range
    function invalid(v) {
      return v === null || isNaN(v) || v < -1.0 || v > 1.0;
    }
    if (invalid(n_mean19) || invalid(n_meanCl) || invalid(z_mean19) || invalid(z_meanCl)) {
      console.log(`Namibia NDVI19/Climo: ${n_mean19}/${n_meanCl}`);
      console.log(`Zimbabwe NDVI19/Climo: ${z_mean19}/${z_meanCl}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const n_anom = n_mean19 - n_meanCl;
    const z_anom = z_mean19 - z_meanCl;

    const n_cloud = (100 * (1 - n_valid / n_total)).toFixed(1);
    const z_cloud = (100 * (1 - z_valid / z_total)).toFixed(1);

    console.log(`Namibia NDVI19: ${n_mean19.toFixed(3)}, Climo: ${n_meanCl.toFixed(3)}, Anom: ${n_anom.toFixed(3)}, ValidPx: ${n_valid}/${n_total} (~${n_cloud}% cloud/masked)`);
    console.log(`Zimbabwe NDVI19: ${z_mean19.toFixed(3)}, Climo: ${z_meanCl.toFixed(3)}, Anom: ${z_anom.toFixed(3)}, ValidPx: ${z_valid}/${z_total} (~${z_cloud}% cloud/masked)`);

    // Final decision: "worse in Namibia" means more negative anomaly in Namibia
    if (n_anom < z_anom) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
